safetyDirectives.title: 5.0 mg/m³ Grease Aerosol Emission Limit for Recirculating Systems
safetyDirectives.mandate: Recirculating ventless cooking systems must continuously restrict grease particulate and condensable aerosol discharge to less than 5.0 mg/m³ of exhausted air during heavy frying challenges. Operating with saturated filters or degraded ESP plates violates indoor air quality codes.

safetyDirectives.title: Fail-Safe Positive Airflow Interlocks & Power Shutoff
safetyDirectives.mandate: The cooking appliance power supply must be electrically interlocked through airflow sensing differential pressure switches. If recirculating airflow drops below design specifications or if access doors are opened, all heating elements must instantly de-energize.

safetyDirectives.title: Semi-Annual Wet Chemical Fire Extinguishing Inspection & Fuel Cutoff
safetyDirectives.mandate: Pre-engineered wet chemical fire extinguishing systems must undergo documented semi-annual inspection by certified fire technicians. Activation must trigger an automatic electrical shunt-trip or magnetic contactor disconnecting all power to induction generators.

safetyDirectives.title: Acrolein & Cooking Oil Volatile Toxic Exposure Thresholds
safetyDirectives.mandate: Acrolein generated from degraded frying oil breakdown is a potent respiratory irritant with an OSHA Permissible Exposure Limit (PEL) of 0.1 PPM (0.25 mg/m³). Saturated carbon filters must be replaced immediately when VOC breakthrough occurs.
